scope: Public-source online course inventory and targeted entry-condition distinctions for a local-only candidate. Not student records, official eligibility, future offerings or complete future-syllabus certification.

catalogueObservation.method: Parsed actual list items, linked course identities and bold markup. Preserved A/C-administered offerings explicitly open to OMSCS; excluded seminars and campus-only specialization references. The initial parser missed optional colons in seven AI titles; corrected parsing on the same captured HTML produced the complete match.

entryConditions.classification: Published course prerequisite / qualifying grade / allowed alternative
entryConditions.finding: The linked faculty syllabus states prior OS study or instructor consent; the current OMSCS overview expects AOS with A or high B, or equivalent study elsewhere. An unknown grade or ordinary B is not confirmed high B. Mandatory weekly 90-minute live attendance is explicit.
entryConditions.implementation: Reject a calendar missing the prerequisite or an explicitly reported allowed alternative. Keep a planned AOS term strictly before SDCC even with two courses per term; future qualifying grades remain conditional. Do not silently rewrite grades.
entryConditions.limit: The current overview links a dated sample syllabus. Current-section permission, grading and registration enforcement were not independently checked.

entryConditions.classification: Expected formal ML background, not a verified CS 7641-only registration lock
entryConditions.finding: The page says this should not be the first ML class and self-study does not count. Equivalent formal introductory ML is permitted background; strong mathematics and Python are expected.
entryConditions.implementation: Expose formal-ML status; warn for an unsupported first-DL plan. Recognize reported prior formal ML or an explicit equivalent-formal-study confirmation. Earlier planned ML stays conditional rather than already completed.

entryConditions.finding: Foundational algorithms/data structures and computer-systems coursework are required; OS/database familiarity is recommended. C++ and systems-programming readiness matter.
entryConditions.implementation: Expose a required-background check without inventing a mandatory GIOS/CS 6400 sequence or offering campus-only undergraduate classes as new degree choices.

entryConditions.finding: The OMSCS overview lists prior statistics grades and data subjects. The linked Fall 2026 faculty page places those formal conditions under an undergraduate cross-listing and permits learned equivalent background for its graduate cross-listing.
entryConditions.implementation: Flag current graduate-section confirmation and ML/programming/ETL/statistics/data readiness. Do not impose an unverified undergraduate named-course chain on OMSCS.

entryConditions.classification: Explicit no-enforcement control with expected background
entryConditions.finding: The current public page explicitly says no prerequisites are enforced, while expecting graduate-level systems/networking understanding.
entryConditions.implementation: Preserve preparation advice without locking the course behind GIOS or AOS.

additionalContext: Previously captured public course-overview/readiness passages were screened for named-course, grade, permission and required-background wording. Recommended Game AI/KBAI/SDP/GPU preparation remains advice; this is not a claim that every full syllabus or future section was reviewed.
